about: Source of truth for LedgerCraft's status on four separate axes (LC-P2-001). The build report and the app read this file. docs/report/check_status.py refuses any status that its evidence does not support: every named test must exist, 'broad' tests need at least three, 'primary-source verified' needs a verification record file, and anything beyond 'synthetic' real-world validation needs a validation record file. Raise a status only together with that evidence.

limitations: No real client books have been processed. Every result so far comes from generated books with known answers.

No legal item is verified. Official government and ICAI sites could not be opened from the build environment, so references rest on secondary sources. A final copy needs a person to record verifications in the Legal verification register.
Format packs (Schedule III Division I, LLP and non-corporate Guidance Notes) are drafts: line items not compared word by word with the official texts.
Income-tax Act 2025: the depreciation section number is conflicting (33 vs 34); the counterpart of the s.43(1) sixth proviso is not confirmed; Form 26 clause numbers are not mapped.
Golden books are machine-generated and not yet reviewed by a Chartered Accountant; a passing golden test only means nothing changed unexpectedly.
AOP/BOI members' remuneration and HUF salary to Karta are placed in ordinary expense lines; the intended Guidance Note presentation is not verified.
Ageing is from transaction dates (the books carry no due dates); current/non-current is from the group and the user's confirmation, not from repayment schedules.
Inventory is shown at book value; LedgerCraft does not value stock. Deferred tax is not computed.
Word output has not been opened in Microsoft Word; the installer has not been installed on a real Windows PC; neither is code-signed.
Peak memory for one million vouchers is about 1.8 GB (Linux measurement); older PCs with 4 GB RAM may struggle with very large day books.
The Excel reader library (calamine 0.26) can panic on some damaged files; LedgerCraft contains this and refuses the file, but upgrading the library is pending.
A lowercase 'ledgercraft' branch on GitHub clashes with 'LedgerCraft' on Windows and should be deleted.
